requirements.requirement: The system must accept structured user condition intent and trial condition inputs conforming to the schema defined in EVAL-CT-REL-001.
The system must compute an exact match score when a user condition string exactly matches a trial condition string.
The system must compute a partial match score when a user condition partially overlaps with a trial condition string.
The system must compute a synonym-based match score using normalized or equivalent condition terms.
The system must compute embedding-based similarity using embedding_client.py when structured matching does not yield a high-confidence match.
The system must normalize the final relevance score to a value between 0.0 and 1.0.
The system must combine structured match scores and embedding similarity into a single aggregated relevance score using a deterministic weighting strategy.
The system must generate explanation factors indicating which matching strategies contributed to the final score (exact, partial, synonym, embedding).
The system must include per-condition contribution details in the explanation output for each matched trial condition.
The system must return a relevance score of 0.0 when no structured or embedding similarity exceeds a minimum threshold.
The system must handle multiple user conditions by aggregating scores across all inputs without failure.
The system must handle multiple trial conditions by evaluating each condition independently before aggregation.
The system must return a valid response with score 0.0 and empty explanation factors when user condition input is empty.
The system must gracefully degrade to structured matching only when the embedding_client fails or is unavailable.
The system must ensure embedding similarity scores are computed using consistent input preprocessing (e.g., lowercasing, trimming, normalization).
The system must ensure deterministic outputs such that identical inputs produce identical relevance scores and explanations.
